title: 第9章 不败之地第10章 降龙十八掌Vs玄铁剑法
lines: 江寒的思路，也通过改命点得到了证实。
徐子陵性格安静、是佛家护法，如谪仙般。
可江寒却让他学习九阳神功，和寇仲互补，也算是改变一下他的命运。
两人得江寒醍醐灌顶，一跃成为高手。
随手灌顶的武功，都是江湖上趋之若鹜的存在。
“在扬州城休整两天，我们就直接前往嘉兴。”
寇仲学会九阴真经后，罕见的没有去找竹花帮嘚瑟。
两天后，一行四人踏上了前往嘉兴的路。
杨过祭奠过母亲后，在铁枪庙见到了自己父亲杨康的墓碑。
整个铁枪庙都已经废弃许久，藤蔓和杂草几乎将墓碑完全覆盖。
看着石碑上“不肖徒杨康”的字号，杨过心情五味杂陈。
一方面是自己父亲狼狈为奸，身为宋人却卖国求荣；
另一方面是死后却埋身在此，无人问津。
江寒却有不同看法，说道：“身为杨家后人，最后能葬在铁枪庙，也算是认祖归宗了。”
杨过、寇仲和徐子陵，三人动手将铁枪庙重新整理布置，把墓碑前的杂草清理了一番。
破损的墓碑也请人重新刻了一副，写着“不肖子杨过立”。
江寒看着与原本一样的墓碑，心中感慨万千。
原版的杨过经历了二十几年的波折，最终才得知了真相，立下了这块碑。
现在杨过不过十四岁，就已经有了同样的心思和志向，该说不说这全靠他改命的功劳。
江寒现在是愈发期待杨过未来的表现了。
“多谢师傅带我来此祭奠父母。”
杨过对江寒的感激是发自肺腑。
拜入独孤峰以来的一个多月，是杨过这辈子过的最无忧无虑、也是最开心的时光。
不用担心有人针对自己，说什么也不用在意旁人目光，完完全全的做自己。
但是杨过冥冥之中有种感觉，师傅为他醍醐灌顶，输送功力，距离他出去闯堂，应该不远了。
“既然事已办妥，那今天我们就在嘉兴醉仙楼好好吃一顿。过儿你身为东道主，得招呼好我们三个。”
“那是一定，保证让你们满意！”
话音刚落，门外突然传来一阵粗犷且焦急的声音：“过儿，真的是你吗？”
这个声音，杨过浑身为之一震。
他怎会忘记这个声音，这殷切期盼声音的主人，正是来自于郭靖。
杨过慌了。
这普天之下没几个令他愧疚之人，恰好面前的江寒和郭伯伯就是。
本以为在回去终南山的时候才能遇到郭伯伯，没想到照面来的如此之快……
一道身影飒沓如流星，快步走进铁枪庙。
来者眉宇宽厚，一张国字脸沉稳，看上去就给人一种可靠忠厚感觉，让人没来由生出好感。
郭靖进入铁枪庙后，乍一看到已经被整理一新的庙宇，不由愣了一下。
旋即看到江寒和气色内力绵长的杨过，又愣了一下。
content_en:
Jiang Han's idea was also confirmed by changing his fate point.
Xu Ziling has a quiet personality and is a Buddhist protector, just like an immortal.
But Jiang Han asked him to learn the Nine-Yang Divine Art and complement Kou Zhong, which could be regarded as changing his destiny.
The two of them were enlightened by Jiang Han and became masters instantly.
The martial arts that can be initiated casually are the ones that people in the world are flocking to.
"After two days of rest in Yangzhou City, we will go directly to Jiaxing."
After Kou Zhong learned the Nine Yin Manual, he rarely went to the Zhuhua Gang for help.
Two days later, a group of four people set foot on the road to Jiaxing.
After Yang Guo paid homage to his mother, he saw the tombstone of his father Yang Kang in the Iron Gun Temple.
The entire Iron Spear Temple has been abandoned for a long time, with vines and weeds almost completely covering the tombstones.
Looking at the name "Unworthy Disciple Yang Kang" on the stone tablet, Yang Guo felt mixed emotions.
On the one hand, his father was a treacherous man who, as a Song Dynasty man, betrayed his country and sought glory;
On the other hand, after death, the body is buried here and no one cares about it.
Jiang Han had a different view and said: "As a descendant of the Yang family, being able to be buried in the Iron Spear Temple can be regarded as recognizing one's ancestors and returning to the clan."
Yang Guo, Kou Zhong and Xu Ziling reorganized the Iron Spear Temple and cleared the weeds in front of the tombstone.
The damaged tombstone was re-engraved with the words "Unworthy Yang Guoli".
Jiang Han looked at the tombstone that was the same as before, feeling filled with emotion.
The original Yang Guo went through more than twenty years of twists and turns before he finally learned the truth and erected this monument.
Now Yang Guo is only fourteen years old, but he already has the same thoughts and ambitions. Whether it be said or not, this is all due to his change of life.
Jiang Han is now looking forward to Yang Guo's future performance even more.
"Thank you, master, for bringing me here to pay homage to my parents."
Yang Guo's gratitude to Jiang Han came from the bottom of his heart.
The more than a month since he visited Dugu Peak has been the most carefree and happiest time Yang Guo has ever had in his life.
Don’t worry about anyone targeting you, don’t worry about what others are saying, just be yourself.
But Yang Guo had a feeling in his mind that the master had given him an enlightenment and transferred his skills, and it shouldn't be far before he went out to try his luck.
"Now that things have been settled, let's have a good meal at Jiaxing Zuixian Tower today. As the host, you have to greet the three of us."
"That's a sure thing, I guarantee you'll be satisfied!"
As soon as he finished speaking, a rough and anxious voice suddenly came from outside the door: "Guo'er, is it really you?"
Yang Guo was shocked by the sound.
How could he forget this voice? The owner of this eagerly awaited voice came from Guo Jing.
Yang Guo panicked.
There are few people in the world who make him feel guilty, and Jiang Han and Uncle Guo happen to be the ones in front of him.
I thought I would meet Uncle Guo when I went back to Zhongnan Mountain, but I didn’t expect the meeting to happen so quickly...
A figure, as swift as a shooting star, quickly walked into the Iron Spear Temple.
The visitor has broad eyebrows and a calm face, which gives people a sense of reliability and loyalty, making people feel good for him for no reason.
After Guo Jing entered the Iron Spear Temple, he was stunned for a moment when he saw that the temple had been renovated.
Immediately he saw Jiang Han and Yang Guo, who looked full of energy, and was stunned again.
title_en: Chapter 9 The Invincible Land Chapter 10 Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms vs Xuan Tie Sword Technique
